d: Monolith discovery sites and transformation worlds in Arthur C. Clarke’s Space Odyssey series.

moon.x: Excavation site of the Tycho Magnetic Anomaly 1 (TMA-1) monolith on the Moon, beaming a radio signal toward Saturn and Jupiter upon exposure to sunlight.

jupiter.x: Giant planet converted into a miniature sun named Lucifer by self-replicating monoliths in 2010: Odyssey Two.

europa.x: Jovian ocean moon transformed into a nascent sun-warmed biosphere in 2010: Odyssey Two ("All these worlds are yours except Europa. Attempt no landing there.").

iapetus.x: Two-tone Saturnian moon whose bright equatorial oval houses the TMA-2 Star Gate monolith in the 1968 novel 2001: A Space Odyssey.

b.s: Hard science-fiction milestone following humanity’s evolution and contact with enigmatic alien monoliths across the Solar System.
